gbm_population_evidence.quote: High Grade Glioma (III or IV); Diffuse Midline Glioma (DMG); Glioblastoma (GBM)

candidate_evidence.quote: Subjects will receive an intravenous infusion of FZ-AD005 until confirmed progression, unaccepted toxicity, or any criterion for withdrawal from the study.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Group B (Recurrent or progressive high-grade glioma)
Patients must be in the maintenance treatment phase following new diagnosis and completion of standard first-line radiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: Subjects will receive an intravenous infusion of FZ-AD005 until confirmed progression, unaccepted toxicity, or any criterion for withdrawal from the study.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational DLL3-directed antibody-drug conjugate with DXd/exatecan-type payload

source_quote.quote: for DLL3 testing, with positive assessment results
Diffuse midline glioma (DMG), with H3 K27 alterated by CLIA-certified laboratory

coder_notes: DLL3 positivity is a whole-trial entry requirement; FZ-AD005 is treated as DLL3-directed because the exclusion criteria refer to prior anti-DLL3 therapies and DXd/exatecan ADCs, but the record never states the target outright. H3 K27 alteration is required only for Group A (post-radiotherapy DMG); Groups A and B are eligibility groups, not registered arm labels. Plasma PK only.
